decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the core pipeline-components business and the growing infrastructure market, so despite some rationalization risk it is more likely to remain in the range.
The ceiling or floor pipe bracket matches the firm's fabrication capabilities and customer base, making it a sensible adjacent product to retain unless demand proves too small.

The powder-coated public waste bin is relatively far from the firm's core water and pipeline offer, so in a growing core market management would likely reallocate capacity away from this side product.

Although the waste-bin-with-ashtray line has several models, it remains outside the main infrastructure portfolio and is a plausible candidate for withdrawal in favor of core products or more fitting developments.
Outdoor public ashtrays are the weakest strategic fit with the firm's established business, so they are the most likely of the remaining products to be discontinued.
